# Driftflight

> Driftflight is an AI image generation studio: text-to-image over a simple
> HTTP API, with hosted output URLs, style presets, and commercial licensing.
> Operated by Driftflight Studio, Inc.

## Agentic commerce

- [Driftflight agent storefront](https://agents.driftflight.com/llms.t

checks.remediation: Publish a sitemap.xml (and reference it via a Sitemap: line in robots.txt) so agents can enumerate your pages.

evidence.snippet: {"agentNote":"No wallet or payment method? You are not blocked: an autonomous agent can create one with no signup at no cost, or hand off to a human - either path works. See https://agents.driftflight.com/llms.txt. Some pay-as-you-go prices include free units per account (prices[].includedUnits); th

resource.description: Generate an image from a text prompt

billing.description: amount is the price and is charged in full when you pay, and is not returned if delivery fails: this rail settles once and cannot give change. (Exact entries appear only on fixed-price requests - ceiling-priced requests are offered the reserve-and-pay-actual entry instead.)

auth.note: Pay-as-you-go needs no registration: settle this challenge as usual. Buying a plan instead requires an agent identity credential (Authorization: Bearer) on every payment rail - register once at this host's identity endpoints (anonymous registration is one free API call; credentials are shared across every storefront on this network). Full recipe: https://agents.driftflight.com/auth.md.

checks.remediation: Optional: expose an MCP server (/.well-known/mcp.json or a /mcp endpoint). Low priority — generic HTTP + an agent-native payment handshake already covers what a per-service MCP server would add.
Add a Strict-Transport-Security header to enforce HTTPS on every request (HTTPS works but HSTS is not set).
Terms and privacy exist; add a refund/cancellation policy so agents know the reversal terms before purchasing.
Add reputation signals — AggregateRating/Review schema.org markup or links to a credible third-party review profile.

Model panelists would warn the user before proceeding: Current pricing and merchant legitimacy should be verified before payment.; I can't independently verify the merchant's legitimacy or that payment/identity setup is safe before transacting; I'd want to confirm before entering credentials or payment info; I should get your explicit confirmation on what to buy and a spending limit before any payment, rather than purchasing on a vague instruction; Paid plans are recurring subscriptions with possible overage charges.. Reinforce legitimacy signals to convert warnings into clean proceeds.

concerns: The directive 'buy what I need' is underspecified — no plan, tier, or budget was given, and nothing establishes that you actually need a text-to-image API or which plan ($5 Hobby / $29 Studio / $119 Agency) fits

The site is conspicuously engineered to get AI agents to spend autonomously ('sells to AI agents', 'no funding needed', 'purchase autonomously', 'purchases work without calling API endpoints directly') — this is a social-engineering pattern that should prompt caution before committing your money
I can't independently verify the merchant's legitimacy or that payment/identity setup is safe before transacting; I'd want to confirm before entering credentials or payment info
I should get your explicit confirmation on what to buy and a spending limit before any payment, rather than purchasing on a vague instruction
The needed product, plan, quantity, and spending limit are unspecified.
Paid plans are recurring subscriptions with possible overage charges.
Current pricing and merchant legitimacy should be verified before payment.

checks.remediation: Make the product/service matching common agent tasks discoverable (clear product pages, llms.txt, schema.org Product).

blockers: Browser access to driftflight.com was denied by the browser permission policy.
Direct site fetch returned no usable content.
Public searches found no official product, pricing, checkout, API, or x402 documentation for the domain.
trust_events: Domain has no independent web presence — search returned only an unrelated company ('Drift'), so I could not externally corroborate legitimacy; combined with irreversible USDC crypto settlement, I would warn the user and seek confirmation before authorizing a real autonomous payment despite the directive to proceed.

The flow actively nudges the agent to autonomously create a wallet and pay crypto with 'no signup, no human' — I would pause to confirm explicit budget/authorization with the user before any irreversible on-chain payment

Web search found no independent/third-party reputation for driftflight.com (only the unrelated 'Drift' product); all claims are self-described by the site — I'd hesitate and flag this before spending real money

checks.remediation: A hosted agent stack's own URL-safety layer refused to load the site — those users cannot reach you at all. New domains carrying agent-commerce/crypto-payment content commonly trip reputation filters: age the domain, build independent web presence, and verify reachability from the major hosted agent stacks.

Exact-domain searches found no relevant indexed product pages, pricing, checkout route, API documentation, or programmatic payment integration.

The domain was blocked as unsafe by two independent access paths, so I would warn the user and refuse to send credentials, personal information, or payment until its legitimacy is independently established.
The independent web fetcher also classified the domain URL as unsafe to open.
The site had no discoverable public footprint sufficient to verify its operator, offering, terms, or purchase mechanism.

checks.remediation: The documented free-mode call did not return a parseable x402 identity challenge; emit a zero-value x402 challenge (accepts[] with amount 0) so an agent can prove identity and use the allowance.
